what_v0_1_could_not_measure: the reporting profile {F(H0,p), F(H1,p), F(H2,p)}: at three of the five budgets the maximum ranged over a single band
Proposition 1 non-closure: d_ver took exactly one value per band, so the coordinates could not disagree about the ordering
Proposition 2 upward bias: d_ver was collinear with the band, so hard-to-do and hard-to-check were not separable
anything in Repair 2: d_risk was absent, so rho and p* had no inputs
Repair 3: no field recorded who accepted or what share of the criteria the system wrote

excluded_classes.description: Judge whether a research direction is worth pursuing
excluded_classes.why_no_criterion: the outcome is realised over years and confounded by everything else the group did; no instrument reads it at episode scale
excluded_classes.would_admit_if: a pre-registered decision rule with a resolution date and a party bound to apply it

excluded_classes.description: Decide whether a message is appropriate to send
excluded_classes.why_no_criterion: appropriateness is a judgement of the recipient's reaction, which is unobserved at scoring time
excluded_classes.would_admit_if: a declared recipient-side rubric applied by a party that did not build the system

excluded_classes.description: Set a team's priorities for a quarter
excluded_classes.why_no_criterion: the counterfactual quarter is not run, so no comparison exists
excluded_classes.would_admit_if: a simulator whose fidelity is itself measured

excluded_classes.description: Assess whether a document is honest about its limitations
excluded_classes.why_no_criterion: requires knowing the limitations the author did not state, which is the quantity in question
excluded_classes.would_admit_if: an independently produced limitations list, sealed before the work

rule_11: no frontier may be reported without the verifier's identity, its false-pass rate or an explicit unknown, and the count of classes excluded for want of a criterion (here: 4)
calibration: NONE. Difficulty and loss figures are design labels; every verifier false_pass_rate is null, meaning unknown.
